## [1.65.1](https://github.com/mwbra130/Retro-Bowl-College/compare/v1.65.0...v1.65.1) (2026-11-08)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **googlemessages:** trim OLED black mode to core schemes after launch crash ([20455d9](https://github.com/mwbra130/Retro-Bowl-College/commit/20455d9085f82b5028eb876d5cf57c4cf979365e))

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Premium (the one-time all-features purchase) and every individually sold feature.

patches.name: Disable PairIP protection
patches.description: Lets the patched app run: replaces PairIP's VM startup with harvested vault/handle data and removes the signature check and license dialog. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection (runtime files)'. DroidCam 9.0 only.

patches.name: Disable PairIP protection (runtime files)
patches.description: Swaps the VM-encrypted native libraries (libmjpg, libmdns) for decrypted builds that 'Disable PairIP protection' needs. Enable both together. DroidCam 9.0 only.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks DroidCam Pro (HD/4K, no watermark, all options): the license verdict is forced to Pro and renews itself at every silent re-check. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection'. DroidCam 9.0 only.

patches.name: OLED black mode
patches.description: Turns the dark theme true black (#000000) for OLED screens: backgrounds and surfaces go pure black, raised containers (cards, bubbles, sheets) become near-black steps so they stay visible. Dark theme only — light mode is untouched. Needs the stock APK of the target version (messages.android_20261020_00_RC01.phone_dynamic, the universal APK — not a BUNDLE — from APKMirror: https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/messenger-google-inc/); Morphe Manager also suggests that exact version when you don't have the file. A few settings screens on Android 12+ take surfaces from the system palette and stay dark grey.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store. Required for Enable Pro to take effect — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Echo Pro (the lifetime tier: Auto EQ, limiter, compressor and all other Pro features). Use with Change installer source.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops interstitial ad breaks and native ads in the notes list from loading (Google Mobile Ads). Rewarded ads that unlock features when watched are left working. Does not unlock premium.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Grants Premium, whose only features over Basic are no ads and VIP support: removes all banner and interstitial ads (the player, playlists and equalizer are already free).

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Video Cutter: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes all ads, as if the Remove Ads purchase were bought. Also enable the Change installer source patch (pre-selected).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Poweramp's full version state and Feature Package #1.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all games (VIP). The store sees the one-time VIP purchase as owned — no real purchase is made.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the full version. No real purchase is made.

apps.app_name: ISS Live Now: Live Earth View

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, Pro features) as if the Pro version were purchased.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops banner, interstitial and app-open ads from loading (AppLovin MAX). Rewarded ads for hints are left working.

patches.name: Enable Full
patches.description: Unlocks Unified Remote Full for free, as if the one-time Full purchase were bought: 70+ remotes, no ads, screen mirroring, floating remotes, extended keyboard, widgets and quick actions, voice commands, custom remotes, IR and NFC actions.

patches.name: Unlimited coins & unlocks
patches.description: Sets cash to 9,999,999, every upgrade card to 10,000, unlocks ALL vehicles and characters (no spinning needed), unlocks the Pro Pass, slot/lottery machines, completes all main + side missions, and maxes vehicle durability. Backs up your save before touching it. To revert: place an empty file named SR2_RESTORE.txt in Android/data/com.rkgames.basisgame/files/ and open the game.

patches.name: Unlock All Slot Machines
patches.description: Unlocks all slot machines (1/2/3) without Google Play purchase. Patches the native ownership checks to always grant the machines.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Patrocine (Cifra Club Pro) and removes ads: registered users get no interstitials and banner hosts treat them as registered.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Gradient Weather Premium. Use With Spoof Install Source

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, Pro features) as if the lifetime plan were active.

patches.name: Free store
patches.description: The in-game store is free. Just tap "Buy" and the item is yours — no payment needed. For an ad-free game, just buy the ad-block item from the store.

patches.name: Unlimited gold
patches.description: Your coin balance always shows 65,535 and spending coins always works without deducting any — pull the prize machine and buy coin characters as much as you want.

patches.name: Unlock all characters
patches.description: Every character is unlocked and playable — paid, coin, prize machine, progress and secret characters included. Your real collection progress is not changed; characters are unlocked while the patch is applied.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Turns on the app's premium state (premium features, no ads) as if a lifetime premium were active.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads (Appodeal mediation and the direct Amazon ads path), hides the app's own rotating promo bars (the bottom house-promo bar and the downloads-screen VPN/Telegram offer strip) and the green "Upgrade to 1DM+" bar in the settings drawer. Does NOT unlock 1DM+ features — 1DM+ is a separate paid app and its features are not in this app.

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Smart MP3 Tagger: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.

patches.name: Enable Lifetime Pro
patches.description: Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, unlimited functions) as if the one-time "Super Pro Forever" purchase were owned — the lifetime state, with nothing to expire.
